item.title: Show HN: Stoke Money – Personal finance app built around a cash flow forecast
item.description: Hi HN, I've been through many finance tracking apps, starting with Personal Capital, then Monarch, and most recently Copilot. None of them have worked perfectly for my needs. All of these apps tend to model “cash flow” as the net sum of your transactions during a month, yet while credit card charges are reported immediately, they are typically deducted from checking (cash) accounts the following month when the bill is due. As a result, I've always had to maintain a separate spreadsheet to track my actual cash flow. These apps also have a huge focus on managing budgets, which has never been… Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.

item.title: Una estudiante de 17 años ha convertido bidones industriales en barriles de lluvia. Su objetivo: que 170.000 litros no acaben en ríos y acuíferos
item.description: La escorrentía es el flujo de agua de lluvia, nieve o deshielo que circula sobre o a través de la superficie terrestre cuando la precipitación supera la capacidad de evaporación e infiltración del suelo. Es un proceso natural en el ciclo del agua y positivo en muchísimos aspectos porque es la principal fuente de agua que llena los ríos, lagos y embalses. Sin embargo, cuando este flujo de agua avanza por el terreno también puede recoger y transportar basura, pesticidas, aceites o metales pesados que pueden llegar a contaminar el agua. item.title: Silicon qubits surpass 99.99% gate fidelity while operating three at once
item.description: Silicon spin qubits are a promising platform for building scalable quantum computers as they are compatible with the semiconductor manufacturing technologies used to produce today's computer chips. However, they have an important weakness: silicon spin qubits typically lose accuracy when several qubits are under parallel control. To be useful, quantum computers will need to operate many qubits simultaneously without compromising the accuracy of their operations. Fuente: Phys.org.
